Fahd and Sam's grandmother, Firyal, who was also in the car, have given their accounts of what happened next. Firyal said that the family stopped the car when they saw Israeli soldiers approaching from a side road to their left. Fahd says he raised his hands after bringing the vehicle to a halt. The funeral has taken place of a seven-month-old Palestinian baby shot dead by an Israeli soldier while in a car with his family in Hebron in the occupied West Bank. According to the Israeli military, a shot was fired when soldiers "perceived a threat" from the vehicle in the Tel Rumeida area on Friday evening. The family say they obeyed soldiers' orders to stop and posed no danger. The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) has acknowledged the family were "uninvolved civilians" and has expressed "deep sorrow" over the incident. The boy's father has dismissed the IDF's expression of regret. The body of Sam Fahd Abu Haikal was laid to rest in Hebron, the day after he suffered a fatal wound from the bullet of an Israeli soldier.

A seven-month-old Palestinian has been laid to rest in the Israeli-occupied West Bank, a day after he was shot dead ‌and his parents were injured by the Israeli military near Hebron, according to family members who witnessed the ‌shooting and the Palestinian health ministry. Sam Fahd Abu Haikal, wrapped in a white shroud ‌and a Palestinian flag, was buried in Hebron after funeral prayers were held at a nearby mosque. The infant was killed on Friday while travelling with his family by car near the city of Hebron. "What happened to us is not a matter of an ‌apology. What happened is ‌not that ⁠shots were fired by mistake and led to this tragedy," ​the child's father, Fahd, said on Saturday.

[Lähde: BBC World]
The funeral has taken place of a seven-month-old Palestinian baby shot dead by an  Israeli soldier while in a car with his family in Hebron in the occupied West Bank.

According to the Israeli military, a shot was fired when soldiers "perceived a threat" from the vehicle in the Tel Rumeida area on Friday evening.

The family say they obeyed soldiers' orders to stop and posed no danger.

The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) has acknowledged the family were "uninvolved civilians" and has expressed "deep sorrow" over the incident. The boy's father has dismissed the IDF's expression of regret.

The body of Sam Fahd Abu Haikal was laid to rest in Hebron, the day after he suffered a fatal wound from the bullet of an Israeli soldier.

His father, Fahd, was joined by a group of mourners as he carried his small shrouded body wrapped in a Palestinian flag to the graveyard.

On Friday, Fahd was driving Sam and other members of his family home from a day out in Bethlehem. They had almost reached the Israeli checkpoint just before their home.

Local residents showed me exactly where their car was hit halfway up the hill to the checkpoint.

Fahd and Sam's grandmother, Firyal, who was also in the car, have given their accounts of what happened next.

Firyal said that the family stopped the car when they saw Israeli soldiers approaching from a side road to their left. Fahd says he raised his hands after bringing the vehicle to a halt.

"The bullets struck the car," Fahd said.

"The soldier that shot at us was 10m away. The bullet penetrated the front windshield, went through my arm, and then struck my son in the head and my wife in the face."

Sam died of his wound in hospital, his mother is still being treated.

At the spot where the shooting happened, local residents pointed out to me traces of what they said was blood on the road.

One local - who did not want to be named - said he heard just two shots fired, adding that there were around four soldiers at the scene.

In its statement on the shooting, the Israeli military said that a single shot was fired after the soldiers "perceived a vehicle accelerating towards them".

But the IDF has acknowledged that the family were what it called "uninvolved civilians" and that the incident is under review.

Dismissing the Israeli expression of regret, Fahd said: "When more than one bullet is fired, when there's no warning shot and no warning at all, it can't be a mistake!"

The Israeli military said that soldiers shot at a vehicle perceived to be accelerating toward them near Hebron. It said an initial inquiry found that the three Palestinians wounded were uninvolved civilians.

Israeli military activity, and settler violence against Palestinians, have surged in the territory since the war in Gaza began in October 2023.

The bullet passed through Sam Fahd Abu Haikal's face.

"He was the entire world," Haikal said of the boy, who turned seven months on Friday.

The mother was in critical condition, with shrapnel close to her heart.

The baby's body was wrapped in a Palestinian flag. His father carried him. The men placed the small bundle at their feet and bowed in prayer.

The father demanded justice. "At the end they tell you it was a mistake," he said. "Nothing is called a mistake."

"The scene was horrific to see a 7-month-old baby with a smashed face," she said. "What kind of army in the world does this?"

payload.title: Israelin sotilaan ampuma seitsemänkuinen vauva haudattiin Hebronissa
payload.summary: Seitsemänkuinen palestiinalaisvauva Sam Fahd Abu Haikal on haudattu Hebronissa miehitetyllä Länsirannalla sen jälkeen, kun hän kuoli Israelin sotilaan ampumaan laukaukseen perheensä autossa.
payload.content:
Seitsemänkuinen palestiinalaispoika Sam Fahd Abu Haikal on haudattu Hebronissa miehitetyllä Länsirannalla päivä sen jälkeen, kun hän kuoli Israelin sotilaan ampumaan laukaukseen ollessaan perheensä autossa. Hautajaisissa lapsen pieni, valkoiseen käärinliinaan peitetty ruumis oli kääritty Palestiinan lippuun, ja hänen isänsä Fahd kantoi sen surevien saattamana hautausmaalle.

## Perhe kertoo pysähtyneensä sotilaiden lähestyessä

Tapaus sattui perjantai-iltana Hebronin Tel Rumeidan alueella. Perhe oli palaamassa kotiin Betlehemissä vietetyn päivän jälkeen ja oli jo lähellä Israelin tarkastuspistettä kotinsa tuntumassa. Autossa olivat lähdetietojen mukaan Sam, hänen isänsä Fahd, muita perheenjäseniä sekä lapsen isoäiti Firyal.

Firyalin kertomuksen mukaan perhe pysäytti auton, kun israelilaissotilaita lähestyi vasemmalta sivutieltä. Fahd on sanonut nostaneensa kätensä ajoneuvon pysähdyttyä. Hänen mukaansa luodit osuivat autoon. Perhe sanoo noudattaneensa sotilaiden käskyä pysähtyä eikä aiheuttaneensa vaaraa.

Lapsen vanhemmat haavoittuivat ammuskelussa perheenjäsenten ja Palestiinan terveysministeriön mukaan. Sam haudattiin Hebronissa sen jälkeen, kun hautajaisrukoukset oli pidetty läheisessä moskeijassa. Paikalliset asukkaat näyttivät lähdetietojen mukaan paikan, jossa auto joutui tulituksen kohteeksi mäellä matkalla kohti tarkastuspistettä.

## Israelin armeija sanoo sotilaiden kokeneen uhan

Israelin armeijan mukaan sotilaat ampuivat laukauksen, koska he kokivat ajoneuvon muodostavan uhan. Israelin puolustusvoimat on samalla myöntänyt, että perhe oli tapahtumaan osaton siviiliperhe, ja ilmaissut syvää surua tapauksesta.

Lapsen isä on torjunut armeijan pahoittelun. Hänen mukaansa tapahtunutta ei voi pitää pelkkänä anteeksipyynnön asiana eikä vahingossa ammuttujen laukausten seurauksena. Fahd sanoi lauantaina, ettei perheen kokema ollut asia, joka ratkeaisi pahoittelulla.

Tiedot tapahtumista perustuvat perheenjäsenten kuvauksiin, Palestiinan terveysministeriön tietoihin sekä Israelin armeijan lausuntoon. Lähteiden mukaan Sam sai kuolettavan haavan sotilaan luodista perjantaina ja hänet laskettiin haudan lepoon seuraavana päivänä Hebronissa.

Perheen mukaan auto oli pysäytetty sotilaiden lähestyessä, eikä perhe aiheuttanut vaaraa.
Israelin armeija sanoo laukauksen ammutun, koska sotilaat kokivat ajoneuvon uhaksi.
